verdict.rationale: The only recurring-scheduling capability in the evidence is commerce-specific: a Subscriptions API and the ability to save recurring payment methods, which implies scheduled recurring billing. Nothing shows general-purpose scheduling of jobs or workflows, and the Subscriptions evidence is only a page title with no detail. Missing for 10: general job or workflow scheduling (cron-like triggers, scheduled automations), documented subscription or recurring-invoice cadence configuration, agent- or MCP-driven scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
